blocks.intro: Many Skokie bathrooms still have their original shower valves behind the tile.

items.body: Older valves use washers and stems that wear. We rebuild them or replace them with a modern valve.
Older valves don't balance pressure, so a flush can make the water spike. A new pressure-balancing valve fixes it.

items.h3: Original Tile Is Hard to Match
items.body: We work through the smallest opening possible.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: We protect the tile when we can.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.h2: Shower Repairs in Vintage Tile Bathrooms
blocks.body: Many Skokie homes still have original tile bathrooms from the 1950s, often in colors that are hard to match. When a valve needs work, we try to do it from behind the wall or through the valve opening, so the tile stays intact. If a valve must be replaced, a trim plate can cover the old holes. You keep the bathroom you like, with a shower that works.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Shower Repair
blocks.body: A cartridge or washer replacement is quick. Replacing an original valve behind vintage tile takes more care. Leak testing adds time. We diagnose and quote a flat price.

items.q: Can you replace an old three-handle valve?
items.answer: Yes. We can install a single-handle pressure-balancing valve, usually with a trim plate that covers the old openings.

items.q: Why does my shower get hot when someone flushes?
items.preview: No balancing valve or a worn one.
items.answer: Older valves don't balance pressure. Installing a pressure-balancing valve solves it.

items.q: Can you fix a drip without opening the wall?
items.answer: Usually. Most drips are fixed by replacing washers, seats or a cartridge through the trim.

items.q: Why is the ceiling under my shower stained?
items.preview: A leak at the valve, drain or tile.
items.answer: A leak at the valve, the drain or failed grout. We find the source before anything is opened.
We can test the pan, drain and valve to find the source.

items.q: Can you replace a tub spout?
items.answer: Yes, including the diverter if it's worn.

items.q: How much does shower repair cost in Skokie?

items.answer: It depends on what's wrong and how we reach it. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
